{{Quote|Don't forget, the lightning bolts don't flow naturally from your fingertips like they did with Emperor Palpatine. Emdee had to implant a cybernetic device inside of you so that you could appear to have the lightning power.|Bertroff Hissa to Trioculus|<ref name="GDV" />}}
A '''lightning device''' was used by the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Trioculus]] to simulate the [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] ability. This piece of [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] technology had been implanted inside Trioculus' body by [[MD-5]], the warlord's private [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]]. Trioculus used it to convince assembled [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]] he was the son of the late [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. However, the warlord had to stop using the implant very quickly, because electricity could prove [[Death/Legends|fatal]] to him.<ref name="GDV" />
